title: Lead-Axis Registry
description: Per-pair frequency record mandated by the Lead-Grid Frequency Standard (docs/lead-grid-frequency-standard.md, adopted 2026-07-14). For every REGISTERED pair (one entry per app/pair_configs/*_config.py) it records the signal's native release frequency, its publication lag, the lead axis that frequency implies (Step 1 HARD RULE), and the anchored grid (Step 3). scripts/gate_lead_axis.py reads lead_axis here as the expected axis and asserts each pair's lead artifacts sit on it. lead_floor / lead_floor_effective / position_shift are enforced by scripts/gate_lead_floor.py (strict floor on the effective lag, standard Step 2 amended 2026-10-16); publication_lag is human-readable reference text.

x-version.description: Semver of the registry instance (separate from this schema's x-version). Bumped whenever a pair is added, reclassified, or its axis/grid changes.

x-owner.description: Single agent accountable for the registry instance.

x-generated.description: ISO-8601 date the instance was last regenerated.

governing_standard.description: Relative path to the standard this registry enforces.

axis_unit_map.description: Convenience map from signal_frequency to lead_axis unit.

pairs.description: Map of pair_id -> frequency record. One entry per registered pair.

signal_frequency.description: The signal's native release/update frequency — the classification of record that sets the lead axis (Step 1).

publication_lag.description: Human-readable release lag with its evidence (e.g. ALFRED first-vintage median/p90 days after period-end). Reference text; the enforced value is lead_floor_effective.

real_time.description: True for market data observed at close (real-time floor L0); false for lagged economic releases (floor L1).

lead_axis.description: The axis unit implied by signal_frequency; the value the gate asserts against the artifacts.

lead_floor.description: Smallest admissible grid lead = lead_floor_effective - position_shift (Step 2, amended 2026-10-16). Enforced by scripts/gate_lead_floor.py.

position_shift.description: Extra bars the strategy applies between the (lead-shifted) signal and the earned return, e.g. strat_ret = pos.shift(1) * ret => 1. Default 0. Read by scripts/gate_lead_floor.py: effective lag = min(grid) + position_shift; must equal what the code does or the gate FAILs (alignment mismatch).

lead_floor_effective.description: STRICT floor on the EFFECTIVE lag (lead + position_shift): the smallest E with first_release(M) <= period_end(M+E-1) on observed release dates (standard Step 2, amended 2026-10-16). Every grid lead and the published winner lead must satisfy lead + position_shift >= this value (scripts/gate_lead_floor.py). When absent the gate uses lead_floor + position_shift.

lead_grid.description: The anchored grid for this axis (Step 3).

observed_winner_lead_unit.description: winner_summary.lead_unit at authoring time — an audit cross-check, not the classification of record.
